rows.capability: A finished change is filed before the session is done — done-gate refuses a live change dir, engine-correct remedy in the message
rows.library: packages/cli/src/integrity.mjs — resolveChangeDir({ forWrite: true }) supplies the live path with no archive fallback (read, not modified)
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/set-phase.mjs — the done-gate function that already holds the combined-ceremony check; runs on every `forge phase done|finish`
rows.writes: refusal on stderr + non-zero exit; on success the session.json phase transition to done/finish
rows.reads: session.openspecChange, session.planType, and whether <plan.dir>/changes/<name>/ exists on disk
rows.uiConsumer: the `forge phase done` refusal the agent and operator read at finish time

rows.capability: An unarchived finish is waived by name and recorded — --archive-waived sets session.archiveWaived without claiming the work was incomplete
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/ledger.mjs — writes the session row that carries the waiver past cleanup
rows.writes: session.archiveWaived in .forge/sessions/<id>/session.json + the archiveWaived field on the .forge/sessions.jsonl row
rows.uiConsumer: `forge analyze` / ledger readers accounting for why a change was left unfiled

rows.capability: The gate is done-only — integrity-check and score stay quiet mid-flight
rows.library: packages/cli/src/integrity.mjs — runIntegrityChecks, deliberately left without the archive check
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/integrity-check.mjs and packages/cli/src/score.mjs — the two non-done callers whose behavior must not change
rows.writes: nothing new; the guarantee is the absence of an archive problem in their output and the retained 20 integrity points
rows.reads: session phase and the live change dir
rows.uiConsumer: `forge integrity-check` output during implement/verify and the session scorecard
